messages:
tori: Heads-up: Vendor P is switching upload API from multipart/form-data to JSON payloads for model artifacts next month. This will break many partner SDKs and marketplace adapters that POST files as form parts. We should propose a compatibility path.
aj: Ack. Do we have counts for multipart usage vs presigned PUTs? helps scope.
vik: Telemetry: ~8 partners use multipart uploads via our API, ~10 use presigned S3 PUTs. Biggest risk: marketplace installers that wrap the multipart call and expect boundary semantics.
meera: Strategy idea: 1) offer a gateway compatibility adapter that accepts multipart and internally converts to the new JSON envelope (base64 or multipart-to-chunks). 2) ship small SDK helpers to encode files to JSON out-of-band. Gateway path is lowest friction for partners who can't update quickly.
tori: Love it. Gateway adapter should be gated per-partner and emit a header so we can track usage. Also add an opt-in flag in the marketplace listing so partners can request longer grace if needed.
aj: I'll add routing flag: "accept_legacy_multipart": true/false and emit metrics "compat.multipart_received" and header "x-compat-multipart". I'll also write alerts for increased request size, spike in parse errors, and base64 decode failures.
vik: For marketplace: add manifest key "legacy_upload_supported": true/false, show a banner on listings with migration steps, and include a one-click opt-in that flips the gateway flag for that partner.
meera: SDK patches: small helpers across languages: 1) warn when using multipart, 2) helper to encode file->base64 JSON envelope, 3) example to perform streaming chunk uploads to the new API. Example snippet for comms:

```
// legacy-to-new upload shim (pseudo)
const fileBuf = fs.readFileSync(path)
const payload = { filename: name, content_b64: fileBuf.toString('base64') }
await client.post('/v2/artifacts', payload)
```

Keep examples language-agnostic in advisory.
tori: Timeline: enable gateway adapter behind flag now, announce 60-day deprecation for multipart, canary rollout: 5% partners for 48h -> 30% for 7d -> full. After 60 days, turn off adapter for non-opt-ins.
aj: I'll prepare a runbook with rollback steps: flip off routing flag, enable presigned upload fallback, and notify ops. PagerDuty playbook for high error-rate.
vik: For SIs, prepare a migration checklist: switch to presigned PUTs where possible, or use SDK helper to encode artifacts. Offer 1:1 migration sessions for top-5 partners.
meera: We'll draft partner advisory with code samples, size limits (max payload base64), and performance notes. Warn about memory footprint for large artifacts; gateway will enforce a 50MB buffered limit for mapped requests.
partner-bot: Draft partner advisory scheduled for 2025-10-01 12:00 UTC (status: draft).
tori: Action items: aj -> routing flag + runbook + alerts; meera -> SDK helper + docs + PRs; vik -> marketplace opt-in UI + listing banners + SI schedule; tori -> coordinate vendor timeline and legal review of advisory.
aj: I'll post PR/runbook links here when ready.
meera: Implementing adapter behind feature flag; will add header "x-compat-multipart" and a short-lived metric so we can throttle. Gateway will return 413 if artifact exceeds 50MB when mapping.
tori: Thanks team  let's target having the adapter + opt-in UI live two weeks before vendor cutover. I'll follow up in #partnerships-ops and schedule partner webinars for top SIs. :thumbsup:
